question: Is the fixed >=0.60 EXACT three-goal bit-match admission requirement mathematically attainable on the AAI-11P frozen three mechanical fixture evaluation, given its actual 6-bit causal laws, 8 goals, no more than two sequential actual do(x_i=0|1) interventions and fixed contexts?
exploratory_note: Independent pre-registration source review and a standalone, not-repo, deterministic enumeration before this audit already indicated only 144/288 two-action-reachable exact goals (50%). This audit is a confirmatory engineering reproduction on original immutable source, not a blinded discovery or new hypothesis and not new scientific data.

frozen_scope.actions: Exactly original 12 possible setbit(6-bit x, index in 0..5, value 0|1), up to two sequential actions including stop; nonchanging interventions allowed but cannot increase attainability.
frozen_scope.goal: Exact equality of all 3 mediator bits to selected goal at terminal state; not mean reward, not number of correct bits. Privileged law oracle is diagnostic-only and never a learner.
frozen_scope.objective: For each original context, enumerate 0-, 1- and 2-action reachable mediator vectors; binary success if any reachable vector equals goal. Repeat each context for N=2 and N=4 as original evaluation does. Independently compute success from exact reward oracle argmax, which prioritizes full three-bit matches if reachable.
frozen_scope.crosscheck: Use two structurally independent methods: explicit Cartesian action-sequence exhaustive enumeration and bounded forward set closure over reachable x states. Check per-context exact reachability agreement, match original world.exact_oracle max reward to unmodified source, and no private equation or oracle in learner calls.
frozen_scope.other_measures: Print per-law and per-fixture reachable exact goal counts, full 64x8 context grid reachability for C/D/E/F, and original full 288-episode oracle reward. Record infeasibility margin in integer successes and original development goal fractions, never retune prior fixed gates.
frozen_scope.frozen_precondition: All original source blobs unchanged; original benchmark exact oracle reward is 2.448263889 and its selected original 12 contexts use hashlib.sha256 source.

prespecified_gate.pass_if: Two independent exact-source reachability methods agree for all original contexts; source oracle maximizing reward has identical exact-goal attainability; original scope, SHA and first-use disarm checked. Audit PASS can classify ORIGINAL_60_PERCENT_GATE_INFEASIBLE if oracle exact-goal rate below .60.
prespecified_gate.failure_classification: If original 60% threshold exceeds exhaustive oracle upper bound, mark BENCHMARK_GOAL_GATE_IMPOSSIBLE, not candidate scientific failure. If any method disagrees or source drift, ENGINEERING_INVALID and fail closed.
prespecified_gate.interpretation: Never retroactively change original AAI-11A/B/D NO-GO; separately frozen reward headroom/strong-control advantage still failed. Audit is proof that one particular gate is infeasible only for these mechanical fixtures. No new threshold selected, no scientific first-use.
prespecified_gate.future_protocol: New benchmark/design or scientifically meaningful candidate acceptance must freeze a feasible ceiling-normalized endpoint and thresholds before development; do not retroactively tune earlier results.

tests.focused: Fresh source-only unit tests for exact action cardinality, same context identities, oracle reward and exact-goal optimal, all law counts, no hidden learner data, no reserved science IDs, first-use disarm
tests.mandatory_full: Full exact-final original native suite and all inherited AAI-11P/11A/11B/11C/11D/11E plus audit tests on both Ubuntu24.04/Windows2022; G29 source-pinned atlas and frozen original main.
